ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd. (GRSE) has set September 18, 2026, as the record date for its final dividend for the financial year 2025-26. Shareholders whose names appear on the company's register by this date will be eligible for the dividend, which is contingent upon approval at the upcoming 110th Annual General Meeting and payable within 30 days of declaration. This is a routine regulatory filing for dividend intimation, with no apparent red flags.
